title: Muraja'ah: linking Al-Haqqah 1 to 36: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Spring 1: Al-Haqqah; noon and meem recap and when letters meet
source: Written for quran/y8 lesson 18 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Muraja'ah rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 18. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

keywords.def: revision of what is already memorised
the link between two sections of a surah

questions.q: Breakout pairs: 'start anywhere' check across 69:1 to 36 (pupil PDF has the start ayat). Today's rota group recites 69:25 to 36 to the teacher.
questions.a: Partner records each start and any prompts; the teacher records rota scores.

questions.q: Extend: write the first two words of each ayah 69:25 to 36 from memory.
After 69:24 (… ٱلْخَالِيَةِ), the next ayah begins ...
questions.a: A) وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ. 69:25 begins وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ.

questions.q: Think again: Can you start Al-Haqqah from the middle? Why does that test your hifdh better than starting at ayah 1?
questions.a: It shows each ayah is known, not just the chain from the start.
